hana: Support hit a 400 on POST /v1/files/upload. Docs show "metadata" as an object ({"owner":"alice","env":"prod"}) but our S3 path expects an array of key/value pairs. Customer payload pasted below. :grimacing:
omar: Can you paste the exact request/response?
hana: Sure:
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/files/upload" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"file_url":"https://...","metadata":{"owner":"alice","env":"prod"}}'
```
Response: 400 {"error":"invalid metadata format"}
julia: Sounds like an OpenAPI vs runtime mismatch. OpenAPI uses additionalProperties -> object, runtime expects `[{"key":"owner","value":"alice"}]`. We should update schema + examples and add a migration note. Can we be lenient server-side?
omar: Ops can accept the object shape for ~60 days on v1 compatibility branch, but we'll deprecate it. I'll open a docs PR to change the schema to `array` and add examples for curl/python/js/go.
docs-bot: omar opened PR #2418: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2418
rafa: SDKs: python/js clients will keep serializing dicts initially; Go's generator may emit map types too. We need small helper snippets and a note in SDK changelogs. Also call out duplicate-key behaviour: object form loses duplicates, array preserves order and duplicates.
hana: Draft snippets I put in the PR:
- curl (array form): {"metadata":[{"key":"owner","value":"alice"},{"key":"env","value":"prod"}]}
- python convert: `if isinstance(metadata, dict): metadata = [{"key":k, "value":v} for k,v in metadata.items()]`
- js convert: `metadata = Array.isArray(metadata) ? metadata : Object.entries(metadata||{}).map(([k,v])=>({key:k,value:v}))`
- go hint: `func ToKV(m map[string]string) []Metadata { /* iterate and append */ }`
julia: Add a short migration section and deprecation banner at top of the endpoint page. Also add a docs CI test that validates example payloads against the OpenAPI schema so we catch regressions.
omar: Agree. I'll add a JSON-schema-based example linter in the PR pipeline. Once CI passes we'll merge and schedule the docs deploy; support will post a KB/notice.
hana: Thanks all! :tada:
